package.name: curobo_task_constructor_interfaces
package.description: Declarative task description for the curobo_task_constructor executor. Owns the open wire format (StageSpec tree, Task action, introspection messages) and deliberately depends only on std_msgs/geometry_msgs/ visualization_msgs — never on isaac_ros_cumotion_interfaces. New stage types extend the schema through the opaque stage_params string without touching any message definition.
